verses.text: O God, save me;O Jehovah, hurry to help me.
May those seeking to take my lifeBe put to shame and disgraced. May those who delight in my calamityRetreat in humiliation.
May those who are saying: “Aha! Aha!” Be driven back in shame.
But let those who are seeking youExult and rejoice in you. May those who love your acts of salvation always say: “May God be magnified!”
But I am helpless and poor;O God, act quickly in my behalf. You are my helper and my rescuer;O Jehovah, do not delay.
